name: VASTS: Virginia Aerospace Science and Technology Scholars
org: Virginia Space Grant Consortium with NASA Langley Research Center
city: Hampton, VA (online course, summer academy at NASA Langley)
what_you_do: Take a free online space and STEM course during the school year. Top scholars can be picked for a six-day summer academy at NASA Langley. Teams there design a crewed mission to Mars and meet NASA engineers.
who_can_apply: Virginia high school juniors and seniors who are at least 16, Virginia residents, and U.S. citizens or permanent residents. A 2.7 GPA is required. You also need a teacher recommendation and a school counselor letter. NASA security rules usually allow only citizens and permanent residents at the summer academy.
pay_detail: Free. Scholars picked for the summer academy get transportation, housing and meals.
duration: Six online modules from late November, then a 6 day summer academy for selected scholars
deadline_text: The page says apply by October 24, 2026. It also lists online course applications as open August 15 to October 25 (a different date), so apply by October 24 to be safe.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Then ask a teacher and a school counselor to send their letters through the online system. They get an email from notices@spacegrant.net. Letters sent any other way are not accepted. Contact: Regina Delzer, rdelzer@odu.edu.
notes: Closing soon. Statewide for Virginia, so it may also appear on another Virginia list. The page says 180 top scholars who finish the course attend the summer academy. The application link is on the program page.
